Keeping a community archive

The volunteers keep an independent copy of every record so that another team can verify each change and recover earlier versions when necessary.

The new archive makes these comparisons easier and preserves the original documents for later study. We will explain the remaining steps in a future article, and you can join our newsletter to receive it.

The public documentation includes a complete example so volunteers can repeat the process and check their results against the same source material.
